effects.name: Limited/full range crush
effects.description: Interpret limited levels as full, then crush the ends.

effects.name: Raised blacks / range wash
effects.description: Compress full levels into a narrower visible range.

effects.name: BT.601 / BT.709 mismatch
effects.description: Decode with a deliberately mismatched color matrix.

effects.name: Clipped highlights
effects.description: Hard clip bright values after gain.

effects.name: Crushed shadows
effects.description: Lift contrast below midgray and discard shadow detail.

effects.name: RGB / BGR swap
effects.description: Exchange red and blue channels.

effects.name: Banding / posterization
effects.description: Quantize channel levels into visible steps.

effects.name: Threshold
effects.description: Collapse luminance to two levels.

effects.name: Hue rotation
effects.description: Rotate chroma phase.

effects.name: Signal polarity inversion
effects.description: Invert the picture values.

effects.name: White-balance cast
effects.description: Bias red, green, and blue gains.

effects.name: Chroma overdrive
effects.description: Increase saturation before clipping.

effects.name: Gamma mismatch
effects.description: Change the transfer curve.

effects.name: Photographic dye fade
effects.description: Reduced saturation, warm shadows, raised black levels.

effects.name: Nearest-neighbor chunkiness
effects.description: Downsample and reconstruct with nearest neighbors.

effects.name: Aliasing / moire
effects.description: Subsample high-frequency detail without a good reconstruction filter.

effects.name: Upscaling softness
effects.description: Bilinear downscale and upscale.

effects.name: Digital zoom blockiness
effects.description: Crop centrally and enlarge using nearest neighbors.

effects.name: Wrong aspect / stretched faces
effects.description: Crop width and stretch back to the output raster.

effects.name: Overscan / hard crop
effects.description: Crop all sides then resize to the working raster.

effects.name: Oversharpening / ringing
effects.description: Unsharp mask creates bright and dark edge halos.

effects.name: Noise-reduction smear
effects.description: Strong spatial and temporal denoising.

effects.name: Lens / bodycam distortion
effects.description: Radial lens distortion.

effects.name: Optical vignette
effects.description: Smooth peripheral darkening.

effects.name: Dropped / duplicated frames
effects.description: Hold sampled frames at a strength-dependent cadence.

effects.name: Uneven frame pacing
effects.description: Alternate short and long frame holds.

effects.name: Bad pulldown cadence
effects.description: Repeat fields with a 3:2 cadence at the working frame rate; cadence model.

effects.name: Frame-conversion double images
effects.description: Mix adjacent decoded frames.

effects.name: Interlace combing
effects.description: Weave alternate lines from consecutive frames; no decorative lines.

effects.name: Wrong field order
effects.description: Weave temporally reversed field lines.

effects.name: Bad deinterlace / bob shimmer
effects.description: Double one field and alternate vertical phase.

effects.name: Frozen video / live audio
effects.description: Hold a video frame for part of each six-second cycle.

effects.name: Timestamp jump appearance
effects.description: Periodic skips and repeated pictures in a playable constant-rate file.

effects.name: B-frame reorder appearance
effects.description: Read the short history buffer out of order.

effects.name: Short picture loops
effects.description: Repeat a captured one-second sequence.

effects.name: Reverse bursts
effects.description: Play the previous half-second in reverse at intervals.

effects.name: Low frame rate
effects.description: Hold pictures at a lower rate while audio continues.

effects.name: Time-lapse cadence
effects.description: Sample sparse frames; preserve duration with holds.

effects.name: Motion-triggered CCTV gaps
effects.description: Hold the last picture when luminance difference falls below a threshold.

effects.name: Temporal slit-scan
effects.description: Each horizontal band comes from a different buffered time.

effects.name: Temporal echo / palinopsia
effects.description: Blend earlier pictures into the current picture.

effects.name: Video feedback
effects.description: Recursively mix the preceding output with a slight spatial shift.

effects.name: Speed-ramp ghosting
effects.description: Animate the mixing weight between temporal samples.

effects.name: Frozen grain / noise texture
effects.description: Add a stationary noise field that does not follow scene movement.

effects.name: Optical-flow interpolation melting
effects.description: Motion-compensated interpolation at a deliberately low source cadence. Very slow on CPU.

effects.name: Sensor luma noise
effects.description: Signal-dependent noise, strongest in darker regions.

effects.name: Chroma noise blotches
effects.description: Low-resolution independent channel noise.

effects.name: Fixed-pattern sensor noise
effects.description: Persistent row and column gain errors.

effects.name: Hot / dead pixels
effects.description: Fixed saturated and black sensor sites.

effects.name: Heat noise build-up
effects.description: Noise amplitude increases through a repeating slow cycle.

effects.name: Low-light gain
effects.description: Boost shadow noise with reduced shadow precision.

effects.name: Radial chromatic aberration
effects.description: Separate color-channel sampling radially.

effects.name: Highlight bloom
effects.description: Blur only over-threshold highlights into neighboring pixels.

effects.name: Lens highlight smear
effects.description: Spread strong highlights horizontally.

effects.name: Optical flare
effects.description: Source-responsive broad glare around the brightest region.

effects.name: Autofocus hunting
effects.description: Slowly vary blur radius.

effects.name: Auto-exposure pumping
effects.description: Time-varying exposure gain.

effects.name: White-balance hunting
effects.description: Time-varying red/blue balance.

effects.name: Rolling-shutter skew / wobble
effects.description: Sample each row with a time-dependent horizontal displacement.

effects.name: Handheld camera shake
effects.description: Smooth frame displacement with reflected edge sampling.

effects.name: Electronic stabilization warp
effects.description: Spatially varying elastic correction.

effects.name: Screen refresh beating
effects.description: Moving broad exposure bands, not a scanline overlay.

effects.name: LED PWM exposure banding
effects.description: Rolling exposure integrates periodic light intensity.

effects.name: IR / night-vision capture
effects.description: Green luminance, amplified noise, highlight bloom.

effects.name: Capture signal-loss flicker
effects.description: Brief, sparse signal attenuation.

effects.name: Chroma bandwidth / bleed
effects.description: Low-pass YIQ chroma horizontally while retaining luminance.

effects.name: Chroma delay
effects.description: Delay chrominance relative to luminance.

effects.name: Composite encode / decode
effects.description: Modulate YIQ onto a sampled subcarrier then imperfectly separate it. Simplified signal model, not standards-accurate NTSC.

effects.name: Composite dot crawl
effects.description: Leak modulated chroma into recovered luminance near transitions.

effects.name: Composite cross-color
effects.description: Decode high-frequency luminance as false chrominance.

effects.name: Tape tracking instability
effects.description: Band-limited row displacement and noisy RF recovery.

effects.name: Head-switching disturbance
effects.description: Bottom-of-picture timing displacement with noisy recovery.

effects.name: Tape RF dropouts
effects.description: Short irregular streaks of missing recovered signal.

effects.name: Head clog / tape wrinkle
effects.description: Occasional broad bands of poor signal-to-noise ratio.

effects.name: Tape stretch / chewing picture
effects.description: Slow horizontal timing collapse and recovery.

effects.name: Vertical hold loss
effects.description: Roll picture address vertically with time.

effects.name: Horizontal sync loss
effects.description: Line-dependent horizontal wrap from sync instability.

effects.name: Mains hum bars
effects.description: Slowly moving wide luma modulation.

effects.name: RF multipath ghost
effects.description: Add an attenuated horizontally delayed signal copy.

effects.name: Color convergence error
effects.description: Offset red and blue recovery horizontally.

effects.name: Phosphor image retention
effects.description: Persist a dim copy of the opening picture.

effects.name: Picture collapse / turn-off dot
effects.description: Compress the picture into a bright line then a small decaying point.

effects.name: Degaussing color wobble
effects.description: Transient radial channel displacement that decays over time.

effects.name: Power-on flash
effects.description: Brief initial exposure surge.

effects.name: RF snow
effects.description: Mix broadband random luminance with the recovered signal.

effects.name: Photochemical grain
effects.description: Luminance-dependent, spatially correlated grain.

effects.name: Film dust
effects.description: Sparse moving dark and bright dust specks.

effects.name: Emulsion scratches
effects.description: Sparse longitudinal scratches with temporal persistence.

effects.name: Film light leak
effects.description: Soft, slowly moving warm exposure spill from a film edge.

effects.name: Projector gate weave
effects.description: Small independent registration errors between pictures.

effects.name: Splice jumps
effects.description: Brief vertical registration jumps at intervals.

effects.name: Vinegar / nitrate / emulsion decay
effects.description: Slowly changing blotches and local warping.

effects.name: Film gate burn
effects.description: Growing luminous irregular hole and brown emulsion boundary.

effects.name: Reel-change cue marks
effects.description: Small ring near the top-right briefly at intervals.

effects.name: Double exposure
effects.description: Combine the picture with a shifted earlier exposure.

effects.name: LaserDisc sparkle / rot
effects.description: Intermittent bright and colored read-error flecks.

effects.name: Corrupt macroblock model
effects.description: Replace sparse blocks with colored or held data; decoded-picture simulation.

effects.name: Corrupt slice model
effects.description: Replace a horizontal picture slice with displaced data.

effects.name: Zeroed YUV appearance
effects.description: Sparse green/pink decoded frames; valid final stream.

effects.name: Decoder error-concealment model
effects.description: Reuse old blocks over a moving scene.

effects.name: Lost-reference trails model
effects.description: Persistent shifted old texture blended into current data.

effects.name: Wrong row stride / wrap
effects.description: Read flattened RGB picture with a changing row start offset.

effects.name: Wrong pixel-format interpretation
effects.description: Reinterpret RGB byte planes as planar channels.

effects.name: Failing VRAM appearance
effects.description: Intermittent tile corruption and channel errors.

effects.name: Missing-texture checkers
effects.description: Replace a chosen region with magenta/black checkers.

effects.name: Pixel sorting
effects.description: Sort horizontal runs above a luminance threshold.

effects.name: Displacement map
effects.description: Smooth two-dimensional procedural displacement.

effects.name: Ordered dither
effects.description: Quantize with a Bayer threshold pattern.

effects.name: Error-diffusion palette
effects.description: Floyd–Steinberg quantization; Python loop, slow at high resolution.

effects.name: False-color / thermal palette
effects.description: Map luminance through a synthetic heat palette; not thermal measurement.

effects.name: Scintillating arc study

effects.name: Half-field loss study
effects.description: Gradually attenuate half of the picture.

effects.name: Local waviness
effects.description: Sine displacement concentrated around a selected region.

effects.name: Regional face distortion
effects.description: Warp a manually placed face region. No automatic face tracker or model download.

effects.name: Motion-blindness study
effects.description: Sparse stills with residual earlier images.

effects.name: Visual snow study
effects.description: Fine noise strongest in dark tones.

effects.name: Drifting floaters
effects.description: Soft moving translucent filaments.

effects.name: Phosphene pattern study
effects.description: Dim moving colored light patches.

effects.name: Micropsia / macropsia region
effects.description: Animate local magnification around a selected point.

effects.name: Retinal curtain study
effects.description: Soft dark boundary sweeps across the picture.

effects.name: Peripheral fading study
effects.description: Gradually suppress peripheral contrast.

effects.name: Uniform field / Ganzfeld study
effects.description: Slowly replace spatial detail with mean field color and faint noise.

effects.name: Tunnel vision / greyout
effects.description: Animated peripheral attenuation and desaturation.

effects.name: Motion adaptation pattern
effects.description: Scrolling luminance pattern followed by a stationary hold. Perceived response varies.

effects.name: Derealization treatment
effects.description: Soft detail, subdued color, lowered contrast.

effects.name: Blocking / mosquito noise

effects.name: 3GP / H.263

effects.name: GIF palette / dither

effects.name: Raw RGB databending

effects.name: Low-pass bandwidth loss

effects.name: Spectral hole

effects.name: Telephone band limiting

effects.name: Small TV speaker

effects.name: Microphone overload

effects.name: Hard clipping

effects.name: Low bit-depth / bitcrush
